post.title: Why glasses, not eye exams, pay America's Best's bills
post.ig:
At America's Best, glasses out-earn eye exams 5 to 1.
Owner National Vision took in $254.7M from eye exams in fiscal 2025, versus $1.27B from eyeglasses and sunglasses.
Exams were just 12.8% of its $1.99B revenue.
As of Jan 2026, 1,645 of its 2,367 optometrists (about 70%) worked for separate professional corporations.
Under the FTC Eyeglass Rule, eye doctors must give patients a free copy of their prescription right after an exam that tests their vision.
Sources: National Vision FY2025 Form 10-K, EssilorLuxottica FY2025 results, FTC.
